---
title: "fig-alt in docx for images and figures (#5514)"
format: docx
_quarto:
  tests:
    docx:
      ensureDocxXpath:
        -
          - '//wp:docPr[@descr="Cross-referenced alternative"]'
          - '//w:t[starts-with(., "Figure") and contains(., "Cross-referenced visible caption")]'
          - '//wp:docPr[@descr="Plain alternative"]'
          - '//w:t[contains(., "Plain visible caption")]'
        - []
---

`fig-alt` must become the Word picture description in `docx`, while the visible caption stays in the document. Without it, Pandoc uses the image caption as description: empty for a cross-referenced figure, as layout moves the caption out of the image, and the caption text for a plain image.

See @fig-static.

![Cross-referenced visible caption]({{< placeholder 200 100 >}}){#fig-static fig-alt="Cross-referenced alternative"}

![Plain visible caption]({{< placeholder 200 100 >}}){fig-alt="Plain alternative"}
